ge-analytical-geometry.name: Analytical Geometry
ge-analytical-geometry.block:
About Analytical Geometry — Generic Elective at Delhi University

Analytical Geometry is a 4-credit Generic Elective (GE) under Delhi University's UGCF/NEP 2022. It is offered to students from other disciplines as an interdisciplinary elective, usually in Semester 1 to 6. Geometry with coordinates and vectors. This page brings together syllabus, previous year papers and study material so you can see the taught order and exam pattern together.

What you will study (broad UGCF outline — verify from your college): The DU syllabus is organised into four units. For Analytical Geometry, the broad coverage is:

  • Unit 1: Coordinate systems & straight lines
  • Unit 2: Circles, conics & transformations
  • Unit 3: Vectors & 3D geometry
  • Unit 4: Applications & problem solving

Exam pattern & marking: Typically 4 credits, 75 marks theory + 25 internal/tutorial or 90+10 depending on college. Sections with choices — e.g., answer 4 out of 6. Units 2-3 carry the most weight, with diagram or data questions where applicable. Internal assessment includes tutorials and presentations. Examiners look for unit-wise structure, one relevant example per answer, and a clear conclusion.

How to prepare & what is missing: Start with Units 1-4 above, then solve the PYQs shown on this page to mark which unit each question came from. That mapping tells you which units repeat most (usually the middle units).
